catalysts.headline: Generac disclosed a long-term supply agreement to provide backup generators for Amazon data centers, with aggregate potential gross payments of up to $8 billion over the life of the arrangement and roughly $2.4 billion of initial deliveries expected across 2027-2028. As part of the deal, Generac issued a warrant to an Amazon subsidiary for up to 1,693,745 shares at a $200.9266 strike price (one source instead describes the initial vesting tranche as 300,000 shares, with the remainder vesting as payments/deliveries occur — see conflicts).
catalysts.impact: Shares were up about 34.5% in premarket trading on the announcement; Cantor Fitzgerald kept its rating and called it the firm's most important data-center-related news item

catalysts.headline: Amazon obtained the right to buy up to $340M of Generac stock as part of a $2.4B backup-generator supply deal for AI data centers
catalysts.impact: stock recorded a record single-session gain the following day

catalysts.headline: Generac reported Q2 2026 results before the open: EPS of $2.91 on revenue of $1.17 billion (+10.6% YoY), with Commercial & Industrial external net sales up ~29% YoY to $556 million; revenue came in slightly below some analyst expectations. Management cited a data-center backlog of $1.6 billion as of July 2026 and said tariff refunds helped margins and cash flow; the Sussex, WI plant was said to be on track to begin production ahead of schedule.

conflicts: Market cap: $13.3B at $224.94 (Trade-Ideas, 2026-10-11) vs. an undated MarketBeat page showing $16.10B at $273.50 — the higher figure is plausibly a mid/late-September 2026 snapshot captured near the post-Amazon-deal spike (shares reportedly jumped ~34.5% on 2026-09-16) before pulling back by October, but this timeline was not independently confirmed with dated prices for both points.

Amazon warrant structure: 1,693,745 total shares with 307,954 vesting immediately at a $200.9266 strike (Pulse2) vs. 300,000 shares available immediately with the remainder vesting as Generac receives payments/supplies generators (DataCenterDynamics) — these two secondary-source descriptions of the same SEC filing do not match exactly and the filing itself could not be fetched this session.
Short interest: no two sources gave a consistent, comparably-dated %-of-float figure (see fundamentals.shortInterest note).

notes: On-file theme 'Advanced Materials' is a clear mismatch — Generac manufactures backup power generators and related energy/power equipment, which is an industrials/energy-equipment business, not a materials-science one. None of the pre-existing theme strings in the provided list (including 'AI Semiconductors', which doesn't fit since Generac makes no semiconductors) genuinely describe this business, so a new theme, 'Backup Power & Energy Equipment', is proposed here; it should be reused verbatim for any other generator/power-equipment names rather than creating near-duplicates. themeLabel 'hot sector' reflects the AI-datacenter-backup-power narrative now driving the stock (the Amazon deal), distinct from Generac's traditional, more cyclical residential-generator business.
